Interface BeanWatchNotifier

All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultBeanContext
@Internal public sealed interface BeanWatchNotifier permits DefaultBeanContext
The side of a WatchableBeanContext that delivers changes to its watches: called by the framework code that makes the changes, such as a development launcher, the configuration refresh, the file watcher and the event publisher, never by a module that watches. Implemented by the default context only; a caller tests for it with instanceof and delivers nothing when the context is another one.
Since:
5.3.0

  • Method Details

    • notifyDefinitionChange

      void notifyDefinitionChange(Collection<? extends BeanDefinition<?>> removed, Collection<? extends BeanDefinition<?>> added)
      Delivers a change of definitions to the watches: the removed definitions are no longer resolvable, the added ones are. A development launcher calls this once per reload, after swapping the definitions.
      Parameters:
      removed - The definitions retired
      added - The definitions added

    • notifyConfigurationChange

      List<ReloadingConfigurationWatcher.Outcome> notifyConfigurationChange(ConfigurationChange change)
      Delivers a configuration change to the watches whose prefix it touches. The configuration refresh calls this after rebinding the configuration beans; a watch answering ReloadingConfigurationWatcher.Outcome.RECREATE has its bean recreated before this returns.
      Parameters:
      change - The change
      Returns:
      The outcomes of the watches delivered to

    • notifyResourceChange

      void notifyResourceChange(ResourceChange change)
      Delivers a resource change to the watches its kind and files concern. An initial change is kept as the state of its kind, which a watch registered later receives as its first batch.
      Parameters:
      change - The change

    • notifyClassChange

      void notifyClassChange(ClassChangeEvent change)
      Delivers a class change to the class change watches, on the calling thread. The event publisher calls this for every ClassChangeEvent it publishes, ahead of the listeners of the event and on the thread that notifies them.
      Parameters:
      change - The change
